title: 'Pot' is short for hashcat's potfile; this page lists every hash that has been cracked.

columns.originalHash: The original hash string as uploaded/cracked, not the recovered password.
columns.domain: The Windows/AD domain extracted from the hash (e.g. NTLM, Kerberos), not a web domain.

filter.filteredBy: {{param}} is the name of the filter field (e.g. 'client', 'hashlist'); {{value}} is its current value.

navigation.backToSource: Generic back button; returns to whichever list (job, client, or hashlist page) the user came from.
